title: Our AI Graded Its Own Work. It Was the Wrong Article.
description: Our AI pipeline reviewed its own blog post and scored it 90. The body was a different article. Why the writer and reviewer must be separate.
ogDescription: A real AI self review that passed the wrong article, and the three checks that catch it.
alt: Archived page with the citations URL but an older post's title
ctaLine: Never let the writer grade its own work.
author: Nick
